customer_name: Hebei Expressway Group Jingxiong Branch (河北高速公路集团有限公司京雄分公司)
business_problem: The Jingxiong Expressway operator struggled with rigid systems, fragmented data, limited video awareness, and slow emergency handling, which prevented highway managers from coordinating quickly with staff and travelers or using operations data effectively.
solution_summary: Baidu AI Cloud helped the Jingxiong Expressway operator build a highway-industry large model on top of general large-model capabilities and highway operating data. The goal was not just to add chat, but to create four specialized model families for event detection, emergency handling, information processing, and business interaction. The system uses industry terminology understanding, knowledge enhancement, and content generation to create a digital operations expert that can detect road events continuously, support intelligent self-handling and decision support, draft operational content, generate reports automatically, and issue business instructions through voice interaction instead of manual navigation through multiple systems. By pretraining on highway data and unifying commands across systems, the platform links sensing, cognition, and decision-making so highway operations can move from passive response to proactive discovery and from fixed manual workflows to flexible multimodal control.

solution_components.name: Highway Industry Large Model
solution_components.role: Uses pretraining on highway data plus large-model reasoning to support event detection, emergency handling, information processing, and business interaction.

solution_components.name: Digital Business Expert
solution_components.role: Serves operations teams with voice-driven commands, content generation, report writing, and intelligent road-event response recommendations.

data_flow: Highway operating data feeds the industry large model, which detects events and analyzes context, then the digital business expert routes the result into emergency handling, information distribution, report generation, and cross-system voice commands for operations teams.
business_outcome: The expressway operator gained a smarter and faster operating model that improves detection, emergency response, and dispatch collaboration while making highway-service operations more responsive for both staff and travelers.
architecture_clues: The solution creates four specialized model families for event detection, emergency handling, information processing, and business interaction.
Voice semantic instructions are designed to work across systems, functions, data sources, and APIs.
The target architecture spans sensing, cognition, decision-making, and forecasting for highway operations.
evidence_quotes: The project forms four dedicated model types for event detection, emergency handling, information processing, and business interaction. (original: 打造高速行业大模型，形成面向事件检测、应急处置、信息处置、业务交互四类专属模型和七项创新应用。)

The system becomes a digital business expert with sensing, cognition, and decision-making abilities that can detect road events around the clock and handle them intelligently. (original: 构建集感知、认知、决策等能力于一身的数字业务专家，具备对发生的道路事件、问题全天候检测和智能决策自处理。)

Voice semantic instructions can reach across systems, functions, data, and APIs to enable data queries, knowledge-base interaction, coordination, report generation, and instruction dispatch. (original: 通过语音语义指令就可以实现跨系统直达、跨功能直达、跨数据直达和跨API的打通，实现语音交互式数据查询、知识库调用交互、多方信息协同、不同系统联动、报告智能生成、指令下发等。)

The project is expected to raise business-system efficiency by over 80%, event-detection accuracy to over 95%, and emergency-handling and information-release efficiency by over 80%. (original: 初步测算，业务系统效率提升80%以上，事件检测准确率提升至95%以上，应急处置效率和信息发布效率提升80%以上。)

Existing systems suffered from fragmented data, rigid workflows, weak video awareness, and slow emergency handling before the large-model rollout. (original: 现行业务系统存在内容与形式单一、操作与流程固化、数据和信息割裂、展示维度和流程设计相对片面、视频感知能效不足，应急处置效率亟待提升等难题。)
